submission.justification: Radiator-R2 at 4 cm thickness provides the best pion/kaon separation performance at 10 GeV/c with a separation power of 4.517 sigma. This significantly outperforms Radiator-R1 (maximum 3.949 sigma at 2 cm) and Radiator-R3 (maximum 2.962 sigma at 4 cm). The 4 cm thickness falls well within the required 1-6 cm constraint and represents the optimal point for R2 where separation power is maximized. The durability check was passed, confirming that R2 maintains its performance over the experiment's lifetime.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c
requirements.evidence: R2 at 4 cm achieves 4.517 sigma separation, the highest among all radiator-thickness combinations tested. This is 14% better than R1's best (3.949 sigma) and 52% better than R3's best (2.962 sigma).

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R2 is one of the three approved candidates (R1, R2, R3) specified in the project documentation.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must keep its performance over the experiment's lifetime
requirements.evidence: Durability check passed (durability_check_passed = 1), confirming R2 maintains performance over the experiment's lifetime.
Recommended thickness of 4 cm is within the valid range of 1-6 cm (R2_valid_min_cm = 1, R2_valid_max_cm = 6).
